WITH CTE1 AS (

    FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_AUMNONUITF
    WHERE H = 'D'
    GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
),

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
    FILE_NAME,
    [DATE],
    INSERT_DTTM,
    REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') AS METRICS,
    SRC,
    TGT
FROM
(
    SELECT 
        TRY_CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS COUNT_SRC,
        TRY_CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS COUNT_TGT,
        TRY_CAST(INVESTMENT_AMT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS INVESTMENT_AMT_src,
        TRY_CAST(INVESTMENT_AMT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS INVESTMENT_AMT_tgt,
        TRY_CAST(HOLDING_UNITS_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS HOLDING_UNITS_src,
        TRY_CAST(HOLDING_UNITS_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS HOLDING_UNITS_tgt,
        TRY_CAST(CURRENT_VALUE_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CURRENT_VALUE_src,
        TRY_CAST(CURRENT_VALUE_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) AS CURRENT_VALUE_tgt,
